question: Convert 100 kilograms to miles.

100 kilograms / 1 kilogram per liter = 100 liters
100 liters / 1000 liters per cubic kilometer = 0.1 cubic kilometers
0.1 cubic kilometers * 0.621371192 miles³ per cubic kilometer = 0.062137 miles³

diameter ≈ 2 \* 0.1767 miles ≈ 0.3534 miles

Therefore, the distance of 100 kilograms of water is approximately 0.3534 miles in diameter.
